palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed orange body, pale muzzle and belly, blue source eyes with dark separation, dark claws and black outline from the approved Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr096 mesh and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Grounded with fixed row-47 shadow. Preserve native lift and recoil; never trim Idle or Physical Attack.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Own feet-and-ear-wing travel cycle; endpoint excluded.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Own forward ear-wing flap strike and recovery; ba01 is a full flip and remains unused for Physical Attack.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Own braced ear-wing and mouth release gesture; no invented projectile or glow.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Own lowered ear-wing resting loop; no painted eyelids.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Own ordinary backward recoil. Inverted bd02 and prone bd03 remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Own broad ear-wing body sweep and flip; no synthetic weapon.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two visual cycles of the own ear-wing strike; one PMDO HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Bounded first 0.7 seconds of the own launch with earlier reverse-sampled recovery; late source inversion and wide recovery margin contact are excluded, with no vertical offset invented.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Bounded source ear-wing brace with reverse-sampled recovery; later root rise is excluded and no aura is invented.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Own ready motion with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; endpoint excluded.
